# MBBS Abroads — independent FEFU General Medicine consultancy

MBBS Abroads is an India-facing independent consultancy focused only on Far Eastern Federal University (FEFU) General Medicine in Vladivostok, Russia. It is not FEFU and does not claim official appointment or representation.

## Owner-confirmed consultancy support

Depending on the written agreement, support can cover application and admission guidance, invitation-letter coordination, visa application and document assistance, travel arrangements, FEFU accommodation coordination, arrival and on-ground help, forex guidance, post-arrival paperwork, and ongoing university-settlement support. FEFU and relevant authorities make their own admission, room, visa, and other official decisions.

The written agreement should state the agreed scope and one consultancy fee. FEFU tuition and accommodation, travel, visa-related, insurance, and other provider charges are separate and should be identified by their provider.

## Current official FEFU information

Checked 12 November 2026. Confirm current intake details and your individual assignment directly with FEFU.

- FEFU's 2024 curriculum lists General Medicine (31.05.01) as a full-time, six-year English-language program: https://postupi.dvfu.ru/upload/medialibrary/ddc/03ffkwggj69cpf1pe2bl9ub2azdn08nk/31.05.01_%D0%9B%D0%94_GM_2024%20%28%D0%9C%D0%9E%D0%9F%29.pdf
- FEFU's English-medium admissions page is the source for current program, intake, entrance-subject, place, and tuition details: https://www.dvfu.ru/en/admission/undergraduate/bachelor-s-degree-in-english/
- The published 2026/27 listing shows General Medicine (in English) tuition of RUB 500,000 per academic year. Check the current FEFU listing and contract for the applicable intake and charge.
- FEFU's official double-room page lists monthly charges per bed, by building and room type: https://www.dvfu.ru/about/campus/students/accommodation/double-room.php
- Listed double-room charges include RUB 3,100 per bed/month (RUB 3,200 with a mini-fridge) for 18–20 m² rooms in buildings 1.8 and 2.1–2.6, and RUB 3,500–4,100 (RUB 3,600–4,200 with a mini-fridge) for 25–32 m² rooms in buildings 6–11. FEFU confirms actual availability, room assignment, and current charge.

## Student and family resources

- FEFU admissions: https://www.dvfu.ru/en/admission/undergraduate/bachelor-s-degree-in-english/
- FEFU student information: https://www.dvfu.ru/en/students/
- FEFU accommodation: https://www.dvfu.ru/about/campus/students/accommodation/double-room.php
- India Ministry of External Affairs guidance for students abroad: https://www.mea.gov.in/students-abroad.htm
- India Ministry of External Affairs foreign-travel guidance: https://www.mea.gov.in/dos-and-donts-for-foreign-travel.htm

For Indian regulatory or licensing questions, check current National Medical Commission guidance for the student's admission year. University admission alone does not establish eligibility for medical registration in India.
